def-fmc.title: FMC 与资料观察范围
def-fmc.section: 产品测试材料 · FMC 与资料观察范围
def-fmc.text: 本测试目录将 FMC / 飞行管理计算机用作技术概念。737 是观察平台范围；产品族 A、软件标准 A/B 是独立测试对象。这个定义不描述真实机型的组件树、接口或适航构型。

def-display.title: 显示相关技术域
def-display.section: 产品测试材料 · 显示相关技术域
def-display.text: 本测试目录将显示相关资料独立组织。输入一致性资料同时涉及两个测试领域，这种关联不证明 FMC 与具体显示设备之间的真实信号连接。

def-standard.title: 软件标准的独立身份
def-standard.section: 产品测试材料 · 软件标准的独立身份
def-standard.text: 测试标准 A 与测试标准 B 属于不同的软件说明范围。相同的 FMC 名称不意味着两者适用范围、功能缺陷或升级条件相同。

scope-x.title: 条件 X 的范围说明
scope-x.section: 产品测试材料 · 条件 X 的范围说明
scope-x.text: This constructed note concerns condition X under software standard A. It does not establish that condition Y has the same cause or that the measure described for X applies to Y.

limit-x.title: 措施与解释边界
limit-x.section: 产品测试材料 · 措施与解释边界
limit-x.text: The proposed measure addresses condition X in the described test configuration. A normal observation at another time does not by itself exclude X. The note does not determine the state of an installed aircraft.

scope-y.title: 条件 Y 的独立调查
scope-y.section: 产品测试材料 · 条件 Y 的独立调查
scope-y.text: Condition Y is recorded under test software standard B during a data-check activity. Its trigger and possible cause remain distinct from condition X; neither similarity of wording nor shared FMC context confirms a common cause.

record-a.title: 位置 P1 的软件记录
record-a.section: 产品测试材料 · 位置 P1 的软件记录
record-a.text: Test position P1 is associated with software standard A at the recorded observation time. This is one position record, not a fleet-wide configuration baseline or proof that any improvement was incorporated.

record-u.title: 位置 P2 的未完整记录
record-u.section: 产品测试材料 · 位置 P2 的未完整记录
record-u.text: The supplied test record identifies position P2, but does not establish the software standard or 737 series. The missing values cannot be treated as standard B, not installed, or not applicable.

cross-note.title: 共享输入一致性说明
cross-note.section: 产品测试材料 · 共享输入一致性说明
cross-note.text: This reference discusses a consistency check relevant to the test FMC question and a display-information question. Shared use of this reference does not make the two engineering matters identical.

obs-x.title: 条件 X 观察记录
obs-x.section: 产品测试材料 · 条件 X 观察记录
obs-x.text: One constructed observation describes a difference under condition X. No exposure hours, cycles or fleet occurrence denominator is supplied.

obs-y.title: 条件 Y 观察记录
obs-y.section: 产品测试材料 · 条件 Y 观察记录
obs-y.text: One constructed observation describes a data-check message under condition Y. The condition is retained separately from X until evidence supports a connection.

rev-x.title: R2 范围限定
rev-x.section: 产品测试材料 · R2 范围限定
rev-x.text: This constructed R2 note restricts the described test condition X to subset A1 within standard A. The existing P1 record contains no A1/A2 subset information; its matching result therefore remains unknown. This revision does not explain condition Y.

alias.title: 同名不等于同一性
alias.section: 产品测试材料 · 同名不等于同一性
alias.text: FMC 与 FMS 在此目录不设为同义词。缩写归一必须核对来源定义和平台语境；当前仅将 FMC 与“飞行管理计算机”作为这个演示概念的显示别名。

method-demo.title: 跨事项比较的范围
method-demo.section: 产品测试材料 · 跨事项比较的范围
method-demo.text: 先区分对象、触发条件和材料来源，再比较方案作用。领域相同仅帮助召回；共同原因、适用性和执行状态不能从图的距离或一般关联路径推出。

sb-r0-s1.title: 1. 背景与范围
sb-r0-s1.text: This constructed bulletin addresses condition X under test software standard A. Condition Y has a separate context and is not assumed to share the same cause.
sb-r0-s1.zh: 本资料说明测试软件标准 A 下条件 X 的识别和一致性核查。条件 Y 有独立触发语境，不能仅凭共同的 FMC 背景合并解释。

sb-r0-s2.title: 3. 措施及限制
sb-r0-s2.text: The described measure concerns condition X only. It is not an installed configuration record or evidence of accomplishment. The target software record and the specific concurrent condition remain to be checked.
sb-r0-s2.zh: 所述措施针对条件 X 的说明范围。它不提供实际安装状态，也不证明当前对象已经执行。目标软件记录和具体并行条件仍需分别核对。

sb-r1-s1.title: 1. 背景与范围
sb-r1-s1.text: This constructed bulletin addresses condition X under test software standard A. Condition Y has a separate context and is not assumed to share the same cause.
sb-r1-s1.zh: 本资料说明测试软件标准 A 下条件 X 的识别和一致性核查。条件 Y 有独立触发语境，不能仅凭共同的 FMC 背景合并解释。

sb-r1-s2.title: 2. 引用资料
sb-r1-s2.text: Technical background: FTD-DEMO-34-017, Revision 3. Review limitations: NOTE-DEMO-34-003, Revision 1. Concurrent requirements: RB-DEMO-34-001, Revision 1. WDM-DEMO-34-900 is referenced without an issue identifier.
sb-r1-s2.zh: 技术背景引用 FTD-DEMO-34-017 R3。核查边界参见 NOTE-DEMO-34-003 R1；并行要求由 RB-DEMO-34-001 R1 单独说明。WDM-DEMO-34-900 未指定修订，本次仅登记其引用位置。

sb-r1-s3.title: 3. 措施及限制
sb-r1-s3.text: The described measure concerns condition X only. It is not an installed configuration record or evidence of accomplishment. The target software record and the specific concurrent condition remain to be checked.
sb-r1-s3.zh: 所述措施针对条件 X 的说明范围。它不提供实际安装状态，也不证明当前对象已经执行。目标软件记录和具体并行条件仍需分别核对。

sb-r1-s4.title: 4. 附件与修订说明
sb-r1-s4.text: Attachment A belongs to this bulletin revision. The separately numbered RB is not a revision of this SB.
sb-r1-s4.zh: 附件 A 为本修订的一致性核查清单示例；另一文件 RB 有独立编号和文档身份，不是本 SB 的历史修订。

sb-r2-s1.title: 1. 本次修订
sb-r2-s1.text: Revision 2 restricts the scope of condition X to subset A1 within test software standard A. A record showing standard A alone does not establish subset A1.
sb-r2-s1.zh: 本次修订将条件 X 的说明范围限定到标准 A 中的 A1 子集。仅列明标准 A 的记录尚不能确认属于 A1。

sb-r2-s2.title: 2. 保留的引用
sb-r2-s2.text: The explicit background citation remains FTD-DEMO-34-017 Revision 3. Availability of Revision 4 in a library does not change this citation.
sb-r2-s2.zh: 本修订仍保留 FTD-DEMO-34-017 R3 的明确背景引用。库内另有 R4，不改变该引用的确切版本。

sb-r2-s3.title: 3. 措施及限制
sb-r2-s3.text: The described measure concerns condition X only. It is not an installed configuration record or evidence of accomplishment. The target software record and the specific concurrent condition remain to be checked.
sb-r2-s3.zh: 所述措施针对条件 X 的说明范围。它不提供实际安装状态，也不证明当前对象已经执行。目标软件记录和具体并行条件仍需分别核对。

ftd-r3-s1.title: 1. 调查背景
ftd-r3-s1.text: The observation of condition X is associated with a test scenario under standard A. No fleet occurrence rate is supplied.
ftd-r3-s1.zh: 条件 X 与标准 A 的测试情形有关；现有观察不提供机队发生率。后续方案仍须依据其自身条件使用。

ftd-r3-s2.title: 2. 引用限制
ftd-r3-s2.text: This report does not establish a shared cause for condition Y under standard B.
ftd-r3-s2.zh: 本文档不描述标准 B 下条件 Y 的共同原因，不能据相似措辞作同一机理判断。

ftd-r4-s1.title: 1. 本次更新
ftd-r4-s1.text: This issue adds a note on the completeness of investigation records. It does not declare all prior background invalid.
ftd-r4-s1.zh: 本次增加对调查记录完整性的备注；未说明全部旧版背景失效。是否影响既有意见须按实际段落核对。

note-r1-s1.title: 1. 核查的能力与局限
note-r1-s1.text: A single consistency check describes its observed state and conditions. A normal result alone does not exclude condition X under other conditions.
note-r1-s1.zh: 单次一致性检查只反映所观察时点和条件。正常结果不能单独证明条件 X 在其他条件下不会发生。

rb-r1-s1.title: 1. 并行关系
rb-r1-s1.text: When the measure described in this constructed document is considered, the listed concurrent conditions must also be examined. This text is not an accomplishment or approval record.

sb-r1.en: This constructed bulletin addresses condition X under test software standard A. Condition Y has a separate context and is not assumed to share the same cause.

sb-r1.heading: 2. 引用资料
sb-r1.zh: 技术背景引用 FTD-DEMO-34-017 R3。核查边界参见 NOTE-DEMO-34-003 R1；并行要求由 RB-DEMO-34-001 R1 单独说明。WDM-DEMO-34-900 未指定修订，本次仅登记其引用位置。
sb-r1.en: Technical background: FTD-DEMO-34-017, Revision 3. Review limitations: NOTE-DEMO-34-003, Revision 1. Concurrent requirements: RB-DEMO-34-001, Revision 1. WDM-DEMO-34-900 is referenced without an issue identifier.

sb-r1.heading: 3. 措施及限制
sb-r1.zh: 所述措施针对条件 X 的说明范围。它不提供实际安装状态，也不证明当前对象已经执行。目标软件记录和具体并行条件仍需分别核对。
sb-r1.en: The described measure concerns condition X only. It is not an installed configuration record or evidence of accomplishment. The target software record and the specific concurrent condition remain to be checked.

sb-r1.heading: 4. 附件与修订说明
sb-r1.zh: 附件 A 为本修订的一致性核查清单示例；另一文件 RB 有独立编号和文档身份，不是本 SB 的历史修订。
sb-r1.en: Attachment A belongs to this bulletin revision. The separately numbered RB is not a revision of this SB.

sb-r2.heading: 1. 本次修订
sb-r2.zh: 本次修订将条件 X 的说明范围限定到标准 A 中的 A1 子集。仅列明标准 A 的记录尚不能确认属于 A1。
sb-r2.en: Revision 2 restricts the scope of condition X to subset A1 within test software standard A. A record showing standard A alone does not establish subset A1.

sb-r2.heading: 2. 保留的引用
sb-r2.zh: 本修订仍保留 FTD-DEMO-34-017 R3 的明确背景引用。库内另有 R4，不改变该引用的确切版本。
sb-r2.en: The explicit background citation remains FTD-DEMO-34-017 Revision 3. Availability of Revision 4 in a library does not change this citation.

sb-r2.heading: 3. 措施及限制
sb-r2.zh: 所述措施针对条件 X 的说明范围。它不提供实际安装状态，也不证明当前对象已经执行。目标软件记录和具体并行条件仍需分别核对。
sb-r2.en: The described measure concerns condition X only. It is not an installed configuration record or evidence of accomplishment. The target software record and the specific concurrent condition remain to be checked.

ftd-r3.heading: 1. 调查背景
ftd-r3.zh: 条件 X 与标准 A 的测试情形有关；现有观察不提供机队发生率。后续方案仍须依据其自身条件使用。
ftd-r3.en: The observation of condition X is associated with a test scenario under standard A. No fleet occurrence rate is supplied.

ftd-r3.heading: 2. 引用限制
ftd-r3.zh: 本文档不描述标准 B 下条件 Y 的共同原因，不能据相似措辞作同一机理判断。
ftd-r3.en: This report does not establish a shared cause for condition Y under standard B.

ftd-r4.heading: 1. 本次更新
ftd-r4.zh: 本次增加对调查记录完整性的备注；未说明全部旧版背景失效。是否影响既有意见须按实际段落核对。
ftd-r4.en: This issue adds a note on the completeness of investigation records. It does not declare all prior background invalid.

note-r1.heading: 1. 核查的能力与局限
note-r1.zh: 单次一致性检查只反映所观察时点和条件。正常结果不能单独证明条件 X 在其他条件下不会发生。
note-r1.en: A single consistency check describes its observed state and conditions. A normal result alone does not exclude condition X under other conditions.

rb-r1.heading: 1. 并行关系
rb-r1.zh: 当采用本文描述的测试措施时，应同时核对所列相关条件。本文不是已完成或已批准实施的记录。
rb-r1.en: When the measure described in this constructed document is considered, the listed concurrent conditions must also be examined. This text is not an accomplishment or approval record.

memo-r1.heading: 1. 当前认识
memo-r1.zh: 阅读 SB-DEMO-34-001 R1 后，现有认识是措施范围限定在 X。适用目标尚需实际记录，未形成实施决定。
memo-r1.en: Review of SB-DEMO-34-001 R1 indicates the measure concerns X. Target matching requires an actual record; no implementation decision is recorded.

query-r1.heading: 1. 待核问题
query-r1.zh: 问题：SB-DEMO-34-001 R1 的标准范围，是否与已收到记录的描述粒度相同？缺少子集字段时不应猜测。
query-r1.en: Question: Is the software scope in SB-DEMO-34-001 R1 as specific as the supplied record? Missing subset fields should not be guessed.
